name: Slayers Inc

features.name: Slayer DuelReels
features.description: Expanding wild reels where the surviving slayer's multiplier applies.

features.name: Free spins
features.description: Bonus rounds with more frequent VS symbols.

review:
A cyberpunk 5x4, 14-liner and one of the original DuelReels games. When a VS symbol would join a win, it expands over its reel and two masked slayers with different multipliers fight – the survivor's multiplier covers the whole wild reel.

It's rated 5/5, Hacksaw's highest, so expect long dry spells between duels that actually matter. 15,000x max in every mode. If you've played Duel at Dawn or Phoenix DuelReels, this is the darker, nastier version.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
